summary: AAP uses the `ansible.builtin.sudo` become plugin, so the service account must be able to run any command with sudo: create `/etc/sudoers.d/ansible` with `ansible ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL`, `chmod 600` it and check with `sudo visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ansible`.
questions: How do I give the ansible service account sudo?
sudoers entry for AAP service account
How do I validate a sudoers.d file?
Which become plugin does AAP use on Linux?

answer_card.title: Sudo for the service account
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
echo 'ansible ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/ansible
sudo chmod 600 /etc/sudoers.d/ansible
sudo visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ansible
```
